# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Code (identifiers, comments) must always be in English; documentation/notes may be in Portuguese. Branches: feature/. Commits: Conventional Commits. Never commit without explicit request.
- CRITICAL: before any change (file, command, git), read the `CRITICAL: hooks` section (H1-H7) of `AGENTS.md` and follow it at all costs.
- After every file edit, verify via git diff that no unintended lines were removed or cut.
